quote.text: The past is never dead. It’s not even past.
quote.author: William Faulkner, Requiem for a Nun (1951)

stories.headline: Your October power bill is priced off April’s oil
stories.dek: Core inflation hit 2.2 per cent in August on a 17 per cent electricity tariff set by a window that closed in June. The window that sets next week’s tariff was 15.5 per cent cheaper — and the September spike lands in January.

stories.headline: Thirteen of the fifteen basis points were real. That is the whole story.
stories.dek: The ten-year rose to 5.11 per cent on Wednesday and the breakeven moved two basis points. The bond market is not repricing an oil shock; it is repricing a central bank that decided to hike into one.

stories.headline: Лудомания
stories.dek: Kazakhstan can tell you the names of the hundred and thirty-five thousand people it stopped from placing a bet this spring. It cannot tell you how many of its citizens are ill to within two orders of magnitude.

stories.headline: The party that cannot govern now owns the constitution
stories.dek: Thirty-two seats is three short of a majority and nine more than a veto needs. The CDU, which killed the fix for exactly this in July, no longer holds a single seat in the chamber.

stories.kicker: Buy it once · merino base layers and travel tees
stories.headline: The cheaper shirt has the finer wool. Price is not the spec.
stories.dek: A $65 tee runs 17.5 microns with a nylon core and taped shoulder seams; the $90 one runs 18.9 and the $150 made-to-order one runs 19.5. What the money buys is finish, fit and a story.

stories.headline: Munich hands YMTC an injunction against Micron, on rights nobody examined
stories.dek: Two German utility models, registered in 2020 without a prior-art search and published only last October, now bar an American memory maker from selling NAND in Germany — while the US patent office has already voided the same family.

stories.kicker: 309 billion parameters, MIT licence, and a tape measure
stories.headline: Xiaomi opened MiMo-V2.6. Here is what actually fits.
stories.dek: The card says 67.9 per cent on DeepSWE. The quant that fits a 96-gigabyte card is 41.7 per cent worse at predicting text — and the quant that fits 128GB cleanly did not exist until Tuesday.

stories.headline: The M5 Ultra went on sale, and the memory it was built for now costs more than the machine used to
stories.dek: US$5,499 on Tuesday, S$7,999 here. It beats an RTX 5090 at long context by outlasting it — and the 512GB tier the whole pitch rests on does not exist until late October.

stories.kicker: Four greatest hits, one pair of barrels
stories.headline: Grönefeld shows the Quadrivium, and a seven-and-a-half-second remontoire is the whole argument
stories.dek: €280,000 for 28 pieces in tantalum, shown under photo embargo in April and photographed only yesterday — by which time the brothers had already stopped taking orders.

stories.headline: Swift reopens the biggest-selling album week in history
stories.dek: She told fans the twelve-track configuration was final. Tracks thirteen to sixteen arrive on Friday, eleven months after a debut week of 4.002 million US units — and two days before she collects an award.

stories.headline: The year a twelve-year-old becomes a regulated category
stories.dek: Britain’s under-16 ban moved from announcement to machinery last Friday — and the same fact sheet quietly commits to mandatory break prompts for under-18s using AI chatbots, the first national rulebook to treat a chatbot like a slot machine.

stories.kicker: The invitation · sourdough and home bread baking
stories.headline: The wild yeast in your jar is mostly the same yeast you can buy in a packet
stories.dek: Five hundred starters were sequenced. In 77 per cent of them the commercial baker’s yeast species was over half the fungal reads — and geography predicted nothing at all.

stories.headline: Twelve minutes
stories.dek: In 147,414 accelerometer-wearing adults, twelve minutes a week of genuinely hard effort matched the mortality signal of a hundred and fifty minutes of moderate. Swapping an hour of pottering for an hour of hard work was worth up to thirty per cent.

stories.kicker: The agenda · two things close before October
stories.headline: Book now, plan ahead
stories.dek: Marathon entries shut on the 30th and the Sugimoto closes on the 4th. Everything else here was re-verified at the promoter, the venue or the official box office this morning.
